A '''private hangar''' was owned by the [[Kel Dor/Legends|Kel Dor]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Gnost-Dural]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Gnost-Dural kept the [[TZ-6 executive shuttle]] [[Prosperity (shuttle)|''Prosperity'']] at the [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]], which he and [[Theron Shan]] used on their [[mission to Ziost|mission]] to [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]].<ref name="Annihilation" />
